array.string: cd "__SERVER_DIR__" && if [ -f "__SERVER_DIR__/tunnel/.env" ]; then set -a; . "__SERVER_DIR__/tunnel/.env"; set +a; fi; provider="${TUNNEL_PROVIDER:-cloudflare_quick_worker}"; case "$provider" in cloudflare_quick_worker|cloudflare-worker|quick-worker) export CLOUDFLARED_BIN="__CLOUDFLARED_BIN__"; exec "__NODE_BIN__" "__SERVER_DIR__/tunnel/run_cloudflare_quick_worker.mjs" ;; cloudflare_named|cloudflared|cloudflare) if [ -n "${CLOUDFLARED_CONFIG:-}" ]; then exec "__CLOUDFLARED_BIN__" --config "$CLOUDFLARED_CONFIG" tunnel run; fi; if [ -n "${CLOUDFLARED_TUNNEL_TOKEN:-}" ] && [ "$CLOUDFLARED_TUNNEL_TOKEN" != "replace-with-cloudflare-tunnel-token" ]; then exec "__CLOUDFLARED_BIN__" tunnel run --token "$CLOUDFLARED_TUNNEL_TOKEN"; fi; echo "Missing CLOUDFLARED_TUNNEL_TOKEN or CLOUDFLARED_CONFIG in __SERVER_DIR__/tunnel/.env" >&2; exit 78 ;; *) echo "Unsupported TUNNEL_PROVIDER=$provider" >&2; exit 78 ;; esac
